flows:
Navigate to https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ then Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in a fresh browser tab with no prior state.
Wait for the report page to finish loading.
Look at the verdict banner at the top of the report page.
Assert A verdict banner is visible at the top of the page.
Assert The banner text reads "All 8 claims are true.".
Store The exact text shown in the verdict banner at the top of the report as {{banner_text}}.
